rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for liberty, including general freedom and freedom from imprisonment or government control.

example.english: We have liberty to speak our minds, so we don’t have to worry about saying the wrong thing.
example.traditional: 我哋有言論自由，唔使驚講錯嘢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jau5 jin4 leon6 zi6 jau4 m4 sai2 geng1 gong2 co3 je5
